status_note: Strategy run as ELIMINATED: Week 2's TB pick lost 23-19 to CLE per the fetched final. state.json had not yet been updated via survivor-record at run time. No opportunity-cost logic; recommendation = highest Arbiter probability among non-excluded teams.
process_note: 10-team shortlist (SEA, SF, KC, BUF, NYG, NO, LA, BAL from the matchup-gap power score; PHI and CIN added on moneyline strength after checking own form, in place of CAR/MIN) went through Advocate -> independent Skeptic subagent -> independent Arbiter subagent, with calibration lessons L1-L6 threaded into all three. L4/L5 drove the biggest discounts: PHI (opponent-QB-driven case, weak own form), NO (LV has better own form) and LA (prior-season profile vs. a current injury cluster). L6 shaped the trap curation: NYG's QB drop-off meets an opponent and weather built to exploit it. All 32 teams are on the board (L3).
